chunks: No people cast lots and then entrusted their matter to Allah, the Exalted, except that the lot of the rightful one came out.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْمُحِقِّ: the one who is rightful or in the right
key_terms.سَهْمُ: the lot or marked share drawn
key_terms.فَفَوَّضُوا: they entrusted and consigned the matter

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about casting lots and entrusting the matter to Allah?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that when people resort to casting lots and sincerely entrust the matter to Allah, the outcome aligns with the one who is in the right. The hadith highlights both the juridical use of qur'ah and reliance upon Allah in resolving disputed matters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3390 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"No group of people cast lots (Qur'ah) and entrusted their matter to Allah (swt), the Exalted, except that the lot would favor the one who is rightful."
